department: Faculty of Mechanical Science and Engineering

deadline.value: The faculty page gives no closing date for applications for acceptance.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to mechanical engineering.

supervisor.value: A professor in the faculty must agree to supervise you, and the supervision agreement goes with the application.
supervisor.quote: Zudem benötigen Sie eine/n Hochschullehrer/in der Fakultät Maschinenwesen, der/die sich bereit erklärt, die wissenschaftliche Betreuung Ihrer Promotion zu übernehmen

funding.value: The pages checked do not state how many doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: Admission normally needs a Diploma, Master or Magister, or a state examination, in engineering, science or mathematics.
entry_route.quote: Die Zulassung zur Promotion setzt grundsätzlich einen Diplom-, Master- oder Magistergrad an einer Hochschule

notes: The faculty page is in German. Its English translation of the regulations (22 March 2018) is not legally binding, according to the page.
